trigger: runtime-resolution-intake produced enough parent, launch, shim, or fleet-state evidence to compare runtime identity

steps.action: Require an explicit requested surface. Unknown remains unresolved.
Normalize parent command identity through classifier.py; unknown or sibling-prefix lookalikes remain unresolved. .ps1 versus .cmd in the registered npm directory are the same native package family.
Resolve the effective launch through classifier.py. Require a recognized registered resolver path; metadata alone cannot produce a passing family.
For native-windows requests, fail as shim-shadowing-native when the effective launch uses agentswitchboard-wsl-shim or targets wsl-ubuntu.
Fail as parent-child-divergence when parent and launch runtime families differ without a declared WSL transition.
If fleet state supplies commandPath, require a recognized command family. Unknown state paths are unresolved; recognized disagreement with effective launch is state-command-drift.

Pass native-consistent only when native-windows was requested, parent and effective launch both match the registered native npm OpenCode family, PATH evidence is non-empty, and supplied fleet state is recognized/consistent.

Pass declared-wsl-consistent only when wsl-ubuntu was requested and the effective launch is the registered WSL OpenCode or the registered AgentSwitchboard shim targeting the registered WSL OpenCode path, with non-empty PATH evidence and recognized/consistent supplied state.

Use unresolved-runtime-identity for missing parent/effective launch, empty or missing PATH snapshot, unknown requested surface, unrecognized resolver/state path, missing wrapper target, or a WSL target outside the registered OpenCode path.
Do not mutate the machine. Route native repair, WSL repair, or end-to-end proof to the owning existing surface named in runtime-resolution.registry.json.

proofCeiling: Deterministic diagnosis from supplied evidence only.
